description: Set or switch an actor’s default voice, free. Use the exact current bindingVersion from soclo_hosted_voices_autoload as expectedBindingVersion, or null only when absent, and a stable operationId for this bind. A new bind needs previewId and ownerApprovedAudition true after the owner listened to that preview and saw its exact soclo_hosted_voices_design_status previewText transcript. After an uncertain result repeat the exact original bind. An owner-account voice stays on its own funding connection. A historical bind replay with isCurrent:false needs soclo_hosted_voices_autoload before using the current default.

ownerApprovedAudition.description: True only after the owner listened to this preview and saw its exact soclo_hosted_voices_design_status previewText transcript; provide previewId for a new bind.

name: soclo_hosted_voices_bind
title: Set an actor’s default voice
